scope: Fresh bounded audit of ordinary training/review/analysis entry points, then fixes for two confirmed UI integration defects; not a claim of all 77 scientific capabilities being validated.

findings.trigger: Confirm scale A then select scale B on the same date.
findings.cause: Confirmation reset was bound to the reference record and analysis snapshot, but not to the selected mass record.
findings.fix: Bind confirmation to snapshot + reference ID + mass ID; source change clears confirmation and hides stale output. B0 remains available without a confirmed mass.

findings.trigger: Import valid sleep data and use the normal analysis page without direct context injection.
findings.cause: STATE-SLEEP-MAIN and STATE-SLEEP-TIMING had only science-API context consumers and no normal declaration producer.
findings.fix: Explicit source and nonoverlapping per-night boundary/date declarations; optional main episode; real declaration time, source revision binding, persisted analysis context and downloadable result.
boundaries: No inferred main episode or complete-night claim.
Future declarations or unavailable/deleted/corrected source versions require review.
Current-time reanalysis never silently moves an old month; out-of-window selection keeps the old visible result.
Exact window end is allowed as interval support; timing still uses episode-end half-open membership.
Declared boundary midpoints do not claim measured sleep onset.

findings.trigger: Add a sleep declaration through the normal automatic analysis page, then cross a one-minute analysis refresh without changing the source records.
findings.cause: The draft identity included exact moving window_start and the complete source inventory, clearing drafts on harmless refresh or unrelated records.
findings.fix: Bind drafts to logical mode/window days/period/timezone/source; validate only each episode’s actual supporting versions. Preserve unchanged declarations and main selection; explicitly remove truly out-of-window or revised-source episodes. Calendar and user-selected window changes clear drafts with an explanation.

fixture_correction.details: Two new tests initially referenced nonexistent source_revision.operation; corrected fixture to the actual before/after revision_id boundary. Business assertions unchanged.

remaining_performance_boundary.details: analytics.v13.snapshot bounds health-source rows but history_as_of, sessions_as_of, audit_events and recommendation loading still replay training history. Candidate current-use/feedback rendering can repeat this work. Existing Apple 10k/100k/1m benchmarks do not establish large training-event throughput.
